card.statement:
Our result is greatly inspired by the pioneering work of Lonergan [Lon21], in which quantized Coulomb branches with $\mathbb{F}_{p}$ -coefficients are given a Frobenius-constant structure with Frobenius center constructed from Steenrod operations over the (Borel–Moore) homology of the space of Braverman–Finkelberg–Nakajima triples. Therefore, these central endomorphisms for Coulomb branches are eventually related to Context (2).
∎

For quantum $D$ -modules, Context (3) enters through the conjecture of the second-named author [Lee23]. Here, let $X^{!}$ be a $T^{!}$ -equivariant conical symplectic resolution over $\mathbb{C}$ . In [Lee23], generalizing the work of [Fuk97, Wil20, SW22] to the $T^{!}$ -equivariant setting, central endomorphisms $\Sigma^{T^{!}}$ of the quantum $D$ -module were constructed and related to the $p$ -curvature of the quantum $D$ -module:
card.label: Remark 1.7

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
